- [FAQ](https://veea.shop/faq/): Frequently Asked Questions What material do you use? Each piece is carefully made by hand using either silver-plated copper wire or lightweight aluminum wire, depending on the design. Ear hooks are typically silver-plated copper, but can also be upgraded to 925 sterling silver for an additional CHF 6. Ear studs are made from stainless steel. Is the packaging gift-ready? Yes, each piece comes in handmade packaging that’s ready to be gifted. How long does shipping take? Orders are typically processed within 1–2 business days and delivered within 3–5 business days.
